ruleDefinitions.name: Suspicious Kerberos RC4 Ticket Encryption
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects service ticket requests using RC4 encryption type Note: Unmapped fields: TicketOptions, TicketEncryptionType, ServiceName

sequences.query: (event_id = 4769 AND TicketOptions = "0x40810000" AND TicketEncryptionType = "0x17") AND  NOT (ServiceName = RGX("\\$$"))
